notes: Everything here is Arc TESTNET. The contracts do not exist on Arc mainnet.
The splitter is a minimal proxy clone of splitterImpl, deployed by the factory.
Roles are separated: admin, underwriter, watcher and settler are four distinct accounts.
The deployer is still the agent and the demo payer, which is a testnet shortcut.
Loan #3 was opened and repaid by the underwriter service on its own key, so the LoanOpened and Repaid events fall inside the indexer window and carry timestamps.

admin.purpose: deposit, withdraw free funds, pause, register splitters
admin.note: Also the agent and the demo payer. Testnet only.

underwriter.note: Separated from the admin so a compromised scorer cannot move funds or pause the vault.

watcher.note: Separated from the admin and from the underwriter so a flagger cannot originate credit.

settler.purpose: signs EIP-3009 payments and routes receipts in the hosted seller
settler.note: No vault role. Holds a small float only.

caps.note: GLOBAL_MAX bounds a single position, not the pool. deposit() does not check it, so the vault can hold more than 10 USDC — 42.56 at time of writing. Because STARTER_CAP + 2 * lifetimeRevenue is 238 USDC, GLOBAL_MAX is what binds every advance here.
